[PERSISTENT EXPERIENCE GUIDANCE]
## Consolidated Experience from Similar Tasks
Consolidated lessons: (1) Never assume a manipulation or movement action will succeed. Before any pick, confirm the target object exists, is reachable, and is near the robot; if not, navigate to it or make it visible first. (2) Before moving, verify the intended path is clear; if blocked, replan around or remove the obstacle instead of assuming forward movement will work. (3) Before any place, confirm the robot is actually holding the target object; if not, complete a successful pick first. (4) Sequence actions so preconditions are satisfied: locate/navigate to the object, pick successfully, transport it, then place it.

## Preliminary Thinking
1. Locate the bread, toaster, and plate; verify they exist and are reachable. 2. Navigate to the bread, checking the path for obstacles and replanning if blocked. 3. Pick up a slice of bread only after confirming it is present and within reach. 4. Navigate to the toaster with a clear path, then place the bread in the toaster only while holding it. 5. Activate or wait for toasting if required, then pick the toast only after confirming it is present and reachable. 6. Navigate to the plate, then place the toast on the plate only after confirming the robot is holding it. 7. If any step fails, re-check preconditions such as object presence/reachability, holding status, and path clearance before retrying.
[/PERSISTENT EXPERIENCE GUIDANCE]
